name.km: ទឹកក្រឡុកសាវម៉ាវ

description: A creamy Cambodian street-style rambutan shake.
descriptionKm: ទឹកក្រឡុកសាវម៉ាវ ស្ទីលខ្មែរ។
equipmentKm: ម៉ាសុីនកិន

ingredients.itemKm: ទឹកដោះគោផ្អែម
ស៊ីរ៉ូស្ករ
អំបិលបន្តិច

instructions.text: Add the rambutan, condensed milk, ice and a little syrup to a blender.
Blend until smooth and frothy; taste and adjust sweetness with a pinch of salt.
instructions.tip: A pinch of salt makes tropical fruit taste sweeter and rounder.

instructions.text: Pour into a tall glass and serve immediately over ice.
